answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 45899 Country: Bangladesh Title: Digital version of Tafsira Maraful Quran Question: (1) I want to save digital version of tafsir Ma’ariful Quran in my computer and my office computer for reciting during free time, is it fair? (2) If it is fair ablution is mandatory or not. Answer ID: 45899 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 958/617/L=1434) (1) You may download the digital version of Maariful Quran in your computer. (2) Wudhu is not necessary to read Maariful Quran; however, it is better to do it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
